external_services.name: Elexon BMRS API
external_services.purpose: Source of national wind actual generation (FUELHH) and forecast runs (WINDFOR)
external_services.usage_mode: Offline snapshot ingestion via backend/scripts/ingest.py. Zero live external network calls are made during runtime.

api_endpoints.description: Health check returning status, snapshot SHA-256 integrity, record counts, and delivery dates.
Metadata listing date range, delivery days, preset cutoffs (09:20, 09:50, 15:30), provenance, and SHA-256 hashes.
Day-ahead forecast evaluation with P10/P50/P90 empirical uncertainty bands, outcome metrics, and hourly table.
Forecast revision history and timeline tracking evolution across successive model runs prior to cutoff.
Comprehensive accuracy analytics across January 2026: MAE, RMSE, bias, by-hour, by-level, gate comparison, and look-ahead leakage.

environment_variables.name: VITE_API_URL
environment_variables.purpose: Optional frontend base URL override for backend API calls. Defaults to empty string (using Vite dev proxy in development).

major_features: Decision Brief: Visualizes the latest valid wind forecast strictly available before auction cutoff with P10 firm floor, P50 expected, and P90 upside empirical bands calibrated on other days.
Outcome Reveal Mode: Allows traders to toggle actual outturn curve, compare against uncertainty bands, and view day-level buying performance.
Intraday Forecast Drift: Displays forecast evolution across successive Elexon model runs prior to gate closure.
Accuracy Lab: Multi-dimensional performance metrics including MAE, RMSE, systematic bias (-632 MW / -8.7%), hourly diurnal profile, wind-generation level breakdown, and auction cutoff comparison.
Look-Ahead Trap Demonstration: Empirical proof quantifying how retrospective post-hoc forecast selection leaks future data and falsely inflates accuracy by 17.27%.
Empirical Band Backtest: Validates that leave-one-day-out ratio calibration achieves expected empirical coverage across all delivery hours.
Method & Data Governance: Explains mathematical definitions, sign conventions, Elexon BMRS data pipeline, and cryptographic verification.
Preset & Custom Cutoffs: Native support for EPEX Day-Ahead (09:20), N2EX Day-Ahead (09:50), and EPEX Half-Hourly (15:30) plus arbitrary custom time input.
verified_working_flows: Backend service startup on 127.0.0.1:8000 with pre-warming lifespan handler executing in 271 ms.
Frontend dev server startup on 127.0.0.1:5173 with Vite proxy routing /api requests to backend.
Full-stack end-to-end data retrieval across all five REST endpoints (/api/health, /api/meta, /api/brief, /api/drift, /api/accuracy).
Interactive tab navigation across Decision Brief, Forecast Drift, Accuracy Lab, and Method & Governance tabs.
Delivery date selection and auction cutoff switching updating charts and metrics reactively with client-side session cache.
Outcome toggle revealing actual delivery curve and contextual outturn statistics.
Production frontend build via 'npm run build' generating clean bundle with zero TypeScript or CSS errors.
Backend automated test suite executing 28 passing unit, integration, regression, and snapshot tests in 7.07s.
Backend code hygiene verified with Ruff linter (0 errors) and Ruff formatter (0 changes needed).

recommended_next_steps.title: Initialize Git Repository & Prepare Anonymous Public GitHub Repo
recommended_next_steps.description: Initialize git, configure .gitignore to exclude .venv, dist, and cache files, make initial commit with clean message history, and verify no personal identifiers or secrets exist.

recommended_next_steps.title: Create Multi-Stage Dockerfile and Docker Compose
recommended_next_steps.description: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile bundling the FastAPI backend and built Vite frontend static files (or Nginx reverse proxy), with docker-compose.yml for single-command orchestration.

recommended_next_steps.title: Configure Cloud Deployment (Vercel / Render / Heroku / Cloud Run)
recommended_next_steps.description: Deploy backend to container runtime and frontend to edge hosting with appropriate environment variable configuration (VITE_API_URL).

recommended_next_steps.title: Add Frontend End-to-End & Component Automated Tests
recommended_next_steps.description: Introduce Playwright or Vitest component tests covering user interactions: date picker, cutoff changes, outcome reveal toggle, and chart rendering.

recommended_next_steps.title: Automate Continuous Ingestion & Alerting Pipeline
recommended_next_steps.description: Package backend/scripts/ingest.py into a scheduled background task or cron job to fetch latest Elexon BMRS updates and extend delivery window beyond January 2026.
